reference: Approved phase-one village screenshot; existing placeholder characters/crops excluded as style targets

prompts.characters:
Create a PRODUCTION GAME SPRITE ATLAS, not a scene, for the already approved cozy island village in the reference screenshot. Reference is ONLY palette, lighting, ground/detail style; replace its crude block-faced characters with detailed warm hand-pixelled villagers. Original designs, top-down 3/4 orthographic 2D life sim, not isometric. Clear expressive little faces, natural rounded pixel silhouettes, cloth folds, hair highlights, leather boots, subtle warm dark outlines, no huge rectangular heads. Consistent 16-bit pixel-art scale intended for 32px ground tiles and 38px-tall people. Warm olive/sage, muted terracotta, honey straw, cream, warm brown skin, blue-gray overalls. Sharp pixel clusters, NO smooth painterly brush or vector edges. Real transparent alpha background, no scene, no terrain, no labels, no shadows beyond 1 pixel beneath shoes.
EXACT atlas layout: 1536x1024 landscape, exactly SIX columns and FOUR rows, each cell256x256. Every character logical48x48 enlarged nearest neighbor. Center x128 and identical foot baseline y224 in every cell. All figures 190px tall within the cell (38 logical pixels), equal head/body proportions, at least24px transparent margin. Never cross cell boundaries.
ROWS ARE DIRECTIONS: row1 facing DOWN toward viewer; row2 facing LEFT profile with nose pointing left; row3 facing RIGHT profile with nose pointing right; row4 facing UP away from viewer, backs of heads, NO face/eyes.
COLUMNS ARE: col1 same player farmer standing neutral; col2 that EXACT same farmer walking with left foot forward, arm swung opposite; col3 exact same farmer walking with right foot forward, arm swung opposite; col4 carpenter NPC Aru standing, adult brown side-part hair, sage shirt and cream carpenter apron with tiny tools; col5 cook NPC Milu standing, chestnut hair bun, cream head scarf and faded terracotta blouse, cream cooking apron; col6 produce merchant Xiaoli standing, dark short hair, sage neckerchief and golden ochre vest over cream shirt.
The player in columns1-3 is IDENTICAL outfit and face: woven straw hat with terracotta ribbon, blue-gray overalls over warm cream sleeves, brown boots, small russet scarf. ALL directions keep the same outfit design; only pose/orientation changes. Walking frames shift limbs a maximum of 1-2 logical pixels, keep head and torso height exactly stable. All 24 cells must be filled, each figure isolated. No additional figures or decorative objects.
prompts.crops:
Create a PRODUCTION GAME CROP SPRITE ATLAS matching the approved village environment reference: warm rich detailed crisp 16-bit pixel art, original cozy island farming game, muted sage/olive foliage, cream radish, straw-gold wheat, terracotta-red tomatoes, honey-orange carrots, russet potatoes. Reference is ONLY palette/detail style; do NOT copy its crude placeholder crop shapes. True alpha transparent background, NO soil tiles, NO pots, NO text, no labels, no shadows, no scene.
EXACT layout 1024x1536 portrait, FOUR columns and SIX rows of invisible equal256x256 cells. Each sprite is logical32x32 hard pixel art enlarged exactly8x, not smooth painting. Every plant centered horizontally at x128, root base at y224, and visible plant pixels stay within x24..232,y24..232. At least16px transparent margin. Young stages naturally small, mature stages up to25 logicalpixels high. Each plant fully isolated with NO crossing adjacent cells.
ROWS by species, top to bottom: 1 white round radish with serrated bright green leaves and a cream root shoulder; 2 round layered leaf lettuce; 3 three thin wheat stalks; 4 carrot feathery leaves and orange root shoulder; 5 potato leafy plant with tiny pale violet blossoms, mature stage shows russet tubers at its base; 6 tomato vine supported by one slender wooden stake, with distinct green and ripe fruit.
COLUMNS, left to right, MUST show four distinct GROWTH STAGES for EVERY species: 1 tiny newly emerged 2-leaf seedling, 2 young leafy growth no mature fruit, 3 larger near-mature plant with developing root shoulder/green wheat heads/unripe green tomatoes, 4 fully mature harvestable plant, plump cream radish, large layered green lettuce, golden ripe wheat, bright orange carrot shoulder, ripe russet potato tubers, ripe red tomatoes.
Make silhouettes and leaf details beautiful and readable at actual32px size, plant density similar to polished farming RPG sprites. Do not put harvested loose vegetables in place of growing plants. All roots bottom-aligned at same y224 in all24cells. Uniform light upper left, fine warm shadows, crisp pixel clusters, consistent scale.
prompts.animals: Production pixel art sprite atlas for the same cozy warm island farming game as the reference environment. Upgrade the block-shaped white chicken in that reference to a detailed adorable small white hen with layered cream feathers, round body, little ochre beak and feet, tiny dark shiny eye, terracotta-red comb, subtle warm gray undershadows and crisp brown pixel outline. Keep it a normal chicken, no clothing. True transparent alpha background, NO colored backdrop or soil or labels. Exact square1024x1024 divided into TWO columns and TWO rows, each cell512x512. Row1 col1 hen facing RIGHT, row1col2 identical hen facing LEFT, row2col1 same hen facing FRONT, row2col2 one small warm ivory egg. All subjects have generous empty margins and are centered x256, feet/bottom baseline y448. Pixel art logically32x32 per cell enlarged16x, crispy integer pixel shapes no blur. Hens about22 pixels tall and23wide, egg only9pixels tall6wide. Use same sunlight and muted earthy palette as village; no sparkles, no props, no text, no watermark. This will be sliced into actual32px sprites.

processing.characters: Nearest-neighbor import to 288x192, 6x4 cells of 48px. Binary alpha threshold 0.6, fixed foot (24,44), same offset for all three player poses in each direction.
processing.crops: Nearest-neighbor import to 128x192, 4x6 cells of 32px. Binary alpha, fit into 30x28 area, root baseline (16,29).
processing.animals: Nearest-neighbor import to 64x64, 2x2 cells of 32px. Binary alpha, hen height 20px, egg height 10px; baseline (16,28).

note: Generated original raster assets. No copied Stardew Valley assets. Raw sources excluded from executable export.
